nodes.title: Refresh X access token
nodes.description: Exchange a refresh token (scope offline.access) for a new access token. X rotates refresh tokens: store the returned refresh_token. Defaults to X_REFRESH_TOKEN / X_CLIENT_ID; uses X_CLIENT_SECRET for confidential clients.

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id of the X app (default: X_CLIENT_ID)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
